method.roots: Next.js entry points: app|pages route/page/layout/loading/error/not-found/template/default/route files, middleware.ts, next.config.*
method.importResolution: static regex over import/export-from, dynamic import(), require(), bare side-effect import; @/* -> repo root, relative resolved; extensionless + /index resolution
method.liveness: BFS over the resolved import graph from entry points; a file not reached is DEAD (nothing reachable can execute it)
method.caveat: regex-based import extraction; dynamic string-concatenated specifiers are not resolvable and are reported separately as unresolved
